title: The Great Wall Is 21,196 km — but You Can't See It From Space | China Travel Expert
description:
China's National Cultural Heritage Administration measured the Great Wall at 21,196 km (about 13,171 miles) in 2012 after a six-year survey — roughly half the length of the equator. It was built and rebuilt over more than 2,000 years by many dynasties.

But the famous claim that you can see it from space with the naked eye is a myth. From Apollo to the International Space Station, astronauts have consistently confirmed the wall is too narrow and too low-contrast to pick out unaided.

🧭 Expert Tip: For the wall itself, walk Mutianyu or Jinshanling instead of Badaling — restored, dramatic ridgelines with far fewer crowds.
